lens_summary: Tren A of C3.3.2 closes the capability-bundle split. ExecutionLogProvider port split into three independent ports: ExecutionLogProvider (canonical evidence), ExecutionLogRetention (advance_retained_from), ExecutionLogMaintenance (flush / compact_retired / metrics). The maintenance port intentionally has NO compact_up_to(seq) parameter — maintenance has no opinion on which evidence is logically reachable. SessionExecutionLog in chronos-services holds three Arc<dyn ...> ports + provenance dir. ProviderKind enum + try_adopt + take_over_segmented + ExecutionLogMaintenanceUnsupported are deleted from the consumer path. The anti-stale-waiver ratchet (c33_25_capability_bundle_ratchet.rs, 7 tests) ensures the maintenance escape hatches don't reappear in services+mcp; the ratchet was validated by a RED->GREEN injection on projection.rs. The HEX surface assertion dropped the stale ExecutionLogProviderShape / NoopExecutionLogProvider placeholders. Tren B (services -> ports inversion for native + store) is NOT started until PR #31 is merged and CI is green.
